claims.supporting_quote: semaglutide was well tolerated over 52 weeks and showed clinically relevant weight loss compared with placebo at all doses
claims.text: In a 52-week randomised Phase 2 dose-ranging trial in adults with obesity and without diabetes, estimated mean weight loss was -13.8 percent at the highest daily semaglutide dose (0.4 mg) versus -2.3 percent with placebo, with a dose-dependent response across the semaglutide groups.

claims.supporting_quote: The most common adverse events were dose-related gastrointestinal symptoms, primarily nausea, as seen previously with GLP-1 receptor agonists
claims.text: In the same Phase 2 trial, the most common adverse events were dose-related gastrointestinal symptoms, primarily nausea, as previously seen with GLP-1 receptor agonists.

forbidden_terms: once-weekly semaglutide in adults with overweight or obesity
